note: Four-VM owner estate after migration: Netcup Dial Control plus exactly three retained Oracle VMs (van-trading-core, vekl-worker, oracle-admin), all peers of the Netcup WireGuard hub. Owner decision auth-20260923-owner-estate-rebuild-hermes-becomes-van (supersedes auth-20260923-owner-hermes-source-separate-a1-topology): Hermes and its files are cloned from the old Oracle A1 dial-hermes-control to Netcup; that same A1 is then formatted in place (same instance, IPs and capacity) and bootstrapped into van-trading-core with VAN's own installer, VAN state is carried over from the previous van-trading-core A1, and that previous instance is terminated. Owner instruction 2026-09-24: only the Hermes clone on Netcup and the VAN backup are kept; no old boot volume is preserved. DIAL resource-fabric hosts.json governs the DIAL infrastructure nodes; VAN/VATI authority for van-trading-core remains governed by the VAN repository.

retired_after_cutover.physical_instance: Oracle A1 named dial-hermes-control (the Hermes migration source)
retired_after_cutover.condition: Only after the final Hermes/control delta is cloned to Netcup, Dial Control is active and the source's control role is retired.

retired_after_cutover.physical_instance: the Oracle A1 that ran van-trading-core before the re-role (private IP 10.0.1.233)

private_overlay.rule: Each Oracle VM is an independent outbound peer to Netcup; oracle-admin is not a transit dependency.

lifecycle_rules.oracle_a1_transition: old-dial-hermes-control is the separate dial-hermes-control A1 (migration source), enrolled as a transient overlay peer at 10.77.0.5 only until retired; it is never the van-trading-core VM and is terminated by the owner after cloning.
lifecycle_rules.source_retirement: Final zero-touch certification is forbidden until van-trading-core (10.77.0.4) answers as itself, the migration source is no longer an overlay peer, and OCI reports DIAL_HERMES_CONTROL_SOURCE_OCID as TERMINATED or TERMINATING.

sequence: 2 clone Hermes installation and files from dial-hermes-control to Netcup and verify
3 rebuild oracle-admin and vekl-worker (terminate preserving boot volume, relaunch same shape, subnet and private IP; cloud-init grants ocarun sudo; Run Command and Bastion plugins enabled)
4 after step 2 is verified, reinstall dial-hermes-control and bootstrap it as van-trading-core
5 terminate the previous van-trading-core instance (VATI never ran on it)
owner_rebuild_plan_20260923.supersedes: retired_after_cutover[old-dial-hermes-control].disposition OWNER_TERMINATES_INSTANCE: the A1 is re-roled to van-trading-core instead of terminated
